description: Presence, pause, ring and the small rules of 2B.4 (changelog 58). Spec: docs/protocol.md, "Presence, pause and ring". The presence-*/ring-* FRAMES are in messages.json; this file holds everything that is not one frame: the validation of a presence body, the pause rules, the sender and receiver limits, the nudge machine, the battery maps, the ring state machine, the screenshot picker, the PC's rule for `origin` and the settings resolver. All times are integers (milliseconds, except where a name says seconds). Written by hand from the spec: keep it that way.

presence.name: pause-until-resumed-with-null-remaining
presence.note: null counts as absent, so exactly one of the two is present

presenceDnd.name: dnd-unknown-string-is-absent
presenceDnd.note: a later Android filter the PC does not know: treated as absent, not as an error

presenceDnd.name: dnd-is-case-sensitive
presenceDnd.note: only the three lower-case words are known; any other string is unknown, so absent

presenceDnd.name: dnd-all-is-absent
presenceDnd.note: off is expressed by leaving the field out; the word all is not part of the wire

presenceDnd.name: dnd-and-focus-both-present
presenceDnd.note: the fields are independent; a real snapshot is only ever one side's, but a receiver keeps what it is given

pauseUntil.name: tomorrow-at-0730-is-tomorrow
pauseUntil.note: 08:00 today is only 30 minutes away, less than 2 hours

pauseUntil.name: tomorrow-at-0600-exactly-is-today
pauseUntil.note: at least 2 hours: exactly 2 hours counts

pauseUntil.name: 1h-berlin-across-spring-forward
pauseUntil.note: 02:00 does not exist: one hour of elapsed time ends at 03:30

pauseUntil.name: 1h-berlin-across-fall-back
pauseUntil.note: 02:30 happens twice: one hour of elapsed time ends at the second 02:30

pauseUntil.name: tomorrow-berlin-the-evening-before-spring-forward
pauseUntil.note: 08:00 is a wall-clock time: only 7 hours of elapsed time

pauseGate.name: auto-clipboard-receiver-not-paused
pauseGate.note: the receiver's own gate only: the peer's pause is the sender's business

pauseExpiry.name: peer-resumed-at-expiry
pauseExpiry.note: expiry = arrival + remainingMs; now at the expiry is resumed

pauseExpiry.name: self-8-days-and-1-ms-ahead-is-expired
pauseExpiry.note: a clock set backwards must not freeze the app

lowBattery.name: a-reconnect-at-14-nudges-if-armed
lowBattery.note: the machine is per peer, not per connection: a first snapshot after a connect at 14 % nudges when armed

lowBattery.name: a-reconnect-at-14-does-not-nudge-twice
lowBattery.note: the same episode across a reconnect

lowBattery.name: paused-receiver-suppresses-and-does-not-disarm
lowBattery.note: the nudge is held until the pause ends

batteryMap.name: windows-no-battery-flag-128
batteryMap.note: a desktop PC: nothing is shared and the battery is never polled

presenceRate.name: sender-snapshot-after-hello-carries-the-battery
presenceRate.note: a battery event before the connection is ready sends nothing

presenceRate.name: sender-1-point-is-not-sent-2-points-is
presenceRate.note: the 2 points are counted from the last SENT level (61 is not sent, 60 is 2 below 62)

presenceRate.name: sender-pause-goes-within-1-s-and-expires-on-time
presenceRate.note: the one-shot at the expiry tells the peer, with no 1 s delay

presenceRate.name: sender-pause-is-not-held-by-the-battery-limit
presenceRate.note: a snapshot is the whole current state: the held battery change rides along and its 30 s timer has nothing left to send

ring.name: the-4th-start-in-a-minute-is-rate-limited
ring.note: at 60000 the start of t=0 is a minute old and no longer counts

ring.name: two-minute-cap-then-a-60-s-lockout
ring.note: the continuous total is capped at 120 s; after the cap new starts are refused for 60 s

shot.name: 16-s-old-is-stale
shot.note: a gallery re-index or a restore
